# Rights And Platform Instructions

- Maintain `SOURCE-LOG.md` for original footage, third-party video, images,
  screenshots, music/SFX, fonts/templates, research, AI assets, sponsorships,
  affiliate evidence, permissions, licenses, and unresolved questions.
- Do not invent licenses, permissions, fair-use conclusions, monetization
  eligibility, or platform-policy guarantees.
- Distinguish copyright permission, license terms, fair use/fair dealing, and
  YouTube reused-content monetization risk.
- Preserve sponsorship, affiliate, gifted, loaned, review-unit, and paid
  promotion disclosures near relevant endorsements.
- Review AI disclosure when realistic or meaningfully altered content could
  make viewers believe a real person/place/event/statement/scene is authentic.
- Review made-for-kids classification, children's content quality, and feature
  restrictions.
- Remove or obscure private data, consent-sensitive people, minors' identifiers,
  confidential documents, and embargoed information.
- Escalate harassment, humiliation, dangerous-content, child-safety, privacy,
  defamation, copyright, or policy uncertainty for human review.
